config_dir.description: The directory where configuration files are stored. Can be overridden by -g flag or TRANSMISSION_HOME env var.

minimized.description: Start the application minimized in the notification area. Corresponds to --minimized flag.

rpc_port.description: Port to use when connecting to an existing session (daemon). Corresponds to --port flag.

rpc_host.description: Hostname to connect to for an existing session. Corresponds to --remote flag.

rpc_username.description: Username to use when connecting to an existing session. Corresponds to --username flag.

rpc_password.description: Password to use when connecting to an existing session. Corresponds to --password flag.

torrent_files.description: List of torrent file paths to add at startup. Corresponds to appending files to command line.

user_name.description: The username of the current user, used to construct the default config directory path.
